signatures: makeCommandRegistryLive(projectRoot: string) => Layer<CommandRegistry, never, ... | UsageMetrics | RoutingPreferences>
invariants: CommandRegistry MUST inject the shared UsageMetrics service into /status
CommandRegistry MUST inject the shared RoutingPreferences service into /model
CommandRegistry MUST inject the shared ToolPermissionState service into /permissions and /tools

responsibilities: Register all Command handlers with their service dependencies
prohibited: MUST NOT construct a separate UsageMetrics service for Command handlers
MUST NOT construct a separate RoutingPreferences service for Command handlers
MUST NOT construct a separate ToolPermissionState service for Command handlers
